title: Prevent intervening tasks from contaminating authority and evidence
narrative: Task-local evidence, policy, memory references, and approvals must not bleed across intervening tasks unless an explicit typed handoff shares them. Related contracts: `fangore_insp_isolation_io`, `fangore_insp_handoff_record`. Tracks MH-DOTS-07[^insp-dots-07].
implementation: `CrossTaskIsolationGuard` scopes visible refs per task from `IsolationContract.input_context_refs`; `publish` makes a ref task-local, and `share` is the only path to another task, requiring a `HandoffRecord` whose `evidence_refs` the source can read. Zero, five, and ten intervening tasks never see the published refs. Workspace and effect isolation stay in `workspace_isolation` and `IsolationContract`.
validation: Kind `cross_task_isolation_bleed`. Hard expects no bleed after 0/5/10 intervening tasks, the receiver reading only handed-off refs, and a handoff naming an unreadable ref refused.
